A rope stretches across the centre of the screen, with a golden marker moving back and forth between the player and the opponent; players must quickly tap alternately in the left and right areas at the bottom, each tap pulling the marker one space towards their side. Scoring is achieved by pulling it past the left scoring line, after which the knot resets for another round. The opponent constantly applies force, dragging the marker towards the right red line, and as the score increases, the pull gets stronger, leaving the player with less reaction time. Accidentally tapping the same side or losing rhythm will cause the marker to slide towards the opponent, and crossing their territory means losing. top_apps.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
top_apps.description_short: Immersive puzzle game
top_apps.description_excerpt:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

Can you become the ultimate prank master monkey? Jump in now and start the madness!

top_apps.name: Scan or Scam Cashier Simulator
top_apps.description_short: Manage your shop, scan products, and face scam challenges
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Scan or Scam Cashier Simulator is a fast, funny shop simulation where every scan can make or break your day. Step behind the counter in Scan or Scam Cashier Simulator, scan items, weigh products, and manage strange customers in this chaotic cashier job simulator.

Not all shoppers are honest. Some try to scam you, while others act suspicious. In Scan or Scam Cashier Simulator, you can choose to play fair or prank the prank scammers in this hilarious Scam Pranks Game. Make smart choices, avoid mistakes, and keep your shop under control.

Enjoy unpredictable moments, funny interactions, and fast-paced gameplay that turns a simple cashier simulator into one of the most entertaining shop games. Stay alert, hide risky items, and don’t get caught when things get messy.

Upgrade your store, unlock new items, and grow your business in Scan or Scam Cashier Simulator. If you enjoy shop simulator, pranks game, and funny simulator games, this experience delivers nonstop chaos and fun.

Download now and decide — will you scan honestly or scam smartly?
